mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, role_id, created_at FROM sys_user_role WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id

SELECT r.id, r.role_name, r.role_code, r.status, r.sort_order, r.remark, r.created_at, r.updated_at FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = ur.user_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 1 AND u.status = 1 ORDER BY r.sort_order, r.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user_role (user_id, role_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{roleId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = LAST_INSERT_ID(id)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sys_user_role WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND role_id = #{roleId}
DELETE FROM sys_user_role WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND role_id != #{roleId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user_role WHERE role_id = #{roleId}
